notes: GT CropYield_T column has a trailing space: 'CropYield_T ' - must use exact name with space for SD and N columns.
GT uses response ratio (RR = T/CK) while extraction uses percent change; conversion: RR = 1 + effect_pct/100, or LNRR = ln(T/CK).

Several extraction papers report values in kg/ha (077_Zhang_J_2019, 126_Arif_2017, 130_Azeem_2019, 153_Wei_2022, 184_Yeboah_2018, 219_Xie_2021, 227_Niu_2017, 242_Liu_2014) while GT likely stores in consistent units - need to verify GT units per study.
Paper 016_Li_B_2016 reports total fresh weight over 9 crops (317-476 range) which may need unit alignment depending on GT storage.
Paper 101_Liang_Feng_2014 reports total over 4 seasons (19-59 t/ha range) - GT may store per-season values.
Paper 078_Wang_2012 uses g pot-1 units (22-500 range) - GT may store in different units.
Paper 081_Deenik_2010 uses g pot-1 shoot DM (0.08-13 range) - GT may store in different units.
Paper 082_Jose_2013 uses g pot-1 dry grain biomass (0.2-1.27 range) - GT may store in different units.
Paper 001_Adekiya_2019 uses kg/m2 (0.24-0.98 range) - GT may store in t/ha requiring factor of 10.
The GT CropYield columns cover a wide range (0.12 to 268) suggesting mixed units across studies.
StudyIDs in GT go up to at least 80 but extraction only covers 28 papers - many GT studies have no extraction match.
The extraction field 'n' maps to both gt_control_n and gt_treatment_n (assumed equal replication).
Some extraction observations include pot experiments (g pot-1) which may not be directly comparable to field studies in GT.
Paper 234_Malik_2018 appears in extraction but StudyID 234 may not exist in the 80-study GT sample - verify.

effect_direction.note: GT uses RR = T/CK (response ratio >= 0), extraction uses percent change. Convert: RR = 1 + effect_pct/100. Both treat biochar treatment as numerator/positive direction.

control_definition_notes.gt: Control (CK) - typically no biochar, may or may not include fertilizer depending on study design
control_definition_notes.extraction: Matched control for each treatment arm - may be fertilized control without biochar (factorial design) or unfertilized control
control_definition_notes.note: Some studies use fertilized no-biochar controls while others use absolute no-amendment controls. This can cause systematic mismatches if GT and extraction use different reference arms.
